title: Active Learning of Fractional-Order Viscoelastic Model Parameters for Realistic Haptic Rendering
abstract: arXiv:2512.00667v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Effective medical simulators necessitate realistic haptic rendering of biological tissues that exhibit viscoelastic material properties, such as creep and stress relaxation. Fractional-order models provide an effective means of describing intrinsically time-dependent viscoelastic dynamics with few parameters, as they naturally capture memory effects. However, due to the unintuitive, frequency-dependent coupling among the order of the fractional element and other parameters, determining appropriate parameter values for fractional-order models that yield high perceived realism remains a significant challenge. In this study, we propose a systematic means of determining the parameters of fractional-order viscoelastic models that optimizes the perceived realism of haptic rendering across general populations. translated_title: 面向真实触觉渲染的分数阶粘弹性模型参数主动学习
translated_abstract: 有效的医疗模拟器需要对呈现粘弹性材料特性（如蠕变和应力松弛）的生物组织进行真实的触觉渲染。分数阶模型能够自然地捕捉记忆效应，是描述本质上依赖时间的粘弹性动力学的有效手段，且所需参数很少。然而，由于分数阶元件的阶数与其他参数之间存在不直观的、依赖频率的耦合关系，为分数阶模型确定能够带来高度感知真实感的合适参数值仍然是一项重大挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了一种系统化的方法来确定分数阶粘弹性模型的参数，以优化面向普通人群的触觉渲染的感知真实感。首先，我们证明了分数阶模型的参数可以通过主动学习得到有效优化，使用定性的（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出一种基于主动学习的系统性方法，通过人类感知反馈自动优化分数阶粘弹性模型参数，从而在医疗模拟器中实现对生物组织更真实的触觉渲染。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a systematic active learning approach to determine fractional-order viscoelastic model parameters that optimizes the perceived realism of haptic rendering, enabling more realistic biological tissue simulation in medical simulators.
